newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan steels firm, earnings prospects help.
newsitem.headline: Japan steels firm, earnings prospects help.

text.p: Steelmakers jumped in Wednesday morning trading as institutional investors flocked to shares in the sector, seen to have bright earning prospects, brokers said.

As of 0136 GMT, Nippon Steel Corp shares were five yen higher at 353, with trade totalling 9.555 million shares. NKK Corp rose nine to 266 yen, ranking third with 5.136 million shares. Kawasaki Steel Corp added nine yen to 359.
"Institutional investors are hunting for domestic demand-related issues backed by firm business prospects," a general manager at second-tier brokerage said.
A broker at a "Big Four" brokerage said that as the new business year has started, investors were buying with hopes that the steel sector would become a prominent sector in the coming months.
